regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story house with dark gray cedar shake siding and white trim. The black shingled roof features multiple gables with decorative white trusses in the peaks. White-framed multi-pane windows are distributed across both floors, some glowing with warm interior light. A covered front porch on the image-right has a gabled roof supported by white square columns and is enclosed by black metal railings. A set of light gray concrete stairs with black railings leads up to the porch. The house sits on a light gray concrete foundation above a grassy lawn.

regions.label: <stairs 1>
regions.prompt: A set of light gray concrete stairs ascending towards the image-top. Black metal railings with thin vertical pickets flank both sides, supported by square white posts with flat, overhanging caps. The stairs and railings cast sharp, diagonal shadows onto the concrete steps and the light gray textured foundation wall to the image-left.

regions.label: <railing 1>
regions.prompt: Black metal railing system on a porch and stairs, featuring thin vertical balusters and flat handrails. The railings are supported by square white posts topped with decorative pyramid-shaped caps. One section of railing encloses the porch on the image-left, while two parallel sections flank a set of light gray concrete stairs leading down towards the bottom-right. The railing casts distinct shadows onto the porch floor and steps.

regions.label: <porch 1>
regions.prompt: Elevated porch area featuring a light-grey floor and a set of matching concrete stairs descending toward the bottom right. Black metal railings with thin vertical spindles and flat handrails line the porch edge and both sides of the staircase. These railings are supported by square white posts topped with pyramid-shaped caps. A white door with a black handle is partially visible on the image-left, set into a wall of grey-brown cedar shingles. The entire structure rests on a light-grey textured foundation.

regions.label: <column 2>

A black handrail attaches to its image-left side, supported by thin black vertical balusters. The base of the column is partially obscured by a white square newel post with a flat cap.

layout.prompt:
